dedupe_keys.name: thailand ministry of transport data catalog mot data catalog

description: The MOT Data Catalog is the Thai Ministry of Transport's CKAN portal and lists 639 datasets from its agencies, among them AEROTHAI (179), the Department of Land Transport (122), the ministry's ICT centre (51), the Department of Rail Transport (48), the Office of Transport and Traffic Policy and Planning (39), the State Railway (34), the Department of Highways (32), the Department of Rural Roads (31), Airports of Thailand (28), the Marine Department, the Expressway Authority and the Port Authority. Groups cover air, rail, road and water transport and statistics. Examples include domestic freight and passenger volumes by mode, public transport travel with vehicle counts entering and leaving Bangkok at 10 highway survey points and expressway toll plazas, accidents on the ministry's road network, traffic volume surveys on road sections, CCTV traffic analysis for Bangkok, freight trips on 16 road routes, road lengths and rest areas on rural roads. Coverage is Thailand. Access: free CSV, XLSX, JSON and PDF downloads and a CKAN API; 285 datasets are under Creative Commons Attribution and 226 under the Open Data Commons licence, while 66 have no licence stated. Caveats: much is aggregate statistics in Thai, and spatial network data are rare (few SHP or GeoJSON files). It supports freight and passenger demand analysis, road safety and traffic studies and calibration of national transport models, and complements the Thailand multimodal origin-destination matrices catalogued here.
